title: Edit your tech pack PDF layout
summary: Make your fabric and trim photos easier to read in the PDF. We show how to resize them, edit text, and download your tech pack.
body_markdown:
Change your tech pack details in the main editor and adjust the layout in the PDF. You can resize fabric and trim references and edit connected text directly in the PDF. Check that the text change appears in the main editor too. When you are ready, click Download.


[Watch on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E88Ge4Ap-ys)


## Before you start


- Open your tech pack with the main editor and PDF visible.
- Check the details and material references you want in the PDF.


## How to do it


1.


### Check the editor and PDF


The main editor has your tech pack details. The PDF shows the final document and updates when you change those details.


2.


### Resize the references


Make the fabric and trim reference images bigger where it helps your manufacturer read the page.


3.


### Edit connected text


Click a connected text field in the PDF and change it. Check that the same change appears in the main editor.


4.


### Check and download


Check that the text and images are easy to read. Then click Download to get your PDF.


## An example


### Make the reference images bigger


The example makes two fabric references and one trim reference bigger. It also changes “red fabric” in the PDF, then checks the same field in the main editor.


## Things to check


- Check that the images and text are easy to read after you resize them.
- When you edit connected text in the PDF, check the matching field in the main editor too.
- Check the garment details and layout before you download and share the PDF.


## A few common questions


Can I edit text in the PDF?


Yes. You can edit a connected text field in the PDF. Check that the change appears in the main editor too.


Can I make fabric and trim images bigger?


Yes. You can resize the fabric and trim reference elements in the PDF.


How do I download the PDF?


Check the final PDF, then click Download.


## Video transcript


Read the transcript


In AI Tech Packs, we have two editors. The main editor is on the left and lets you edit the information. On the right is the PDF, your final output. Edits in the main editor are reflected right away in the PDF. In this fabric section, we have two fabric references. We can enlarge these elements to give the tech pack a more cohesive look and make it easier for the manufacturer to read. The same applies to the trim section. We only have one trim, so we can enlarge it. You can also make text edits directly in the PDF. Click a field, for example “red fabric.” When I edit it, the main editor reflects the change too. These changes should be synced. To download the PDF, click Download.
